description: Live position of the International Space Station from wheretheiss.at: latitude, longitude, altitude (km), speed (km/h), and whether it is over daylight. Updates roughly every second on the source; the answer is cached 30 seconds. Not a real-estate dataset. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_nhc_current_storms_v2 when you need Active tropical cyclones from the US National Hurricane. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
